evaluations.note: 17 on the reference machine since the sheared cells of common/data/elastic.tadahdb were corrected (2026-09-30; 30 before, 16 with the previous 15-digit scripts). Since common/lammps/Ecoh_param.in switched to exact captures, HPO reads Ecoh, Eiso and Ebulk and the relaxed lattice constant back without rounding, which exposes the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation. From eval 13 on, DLIB:BFGS's line search re-evaluates the clamped upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0; whether its sufficient-decrease test passes there depends on the sign of that noise. Here it passes after the re-evaluations at the bound (evals 13-15) and BFGS ends after its finite-difference pair (evals 16-17); when it never passes, the run continues to MAXEVAL (30), and a 1-ulp change of the hot_a0 start or of one training energy decides which. So the count is not pinned (evals_tol 14: 3..31, see tolerance_rationale); the status stays COMPLETED in every case, and best loss, components and RCUT2B do not depend on it (1.004806e-01 at eval 10).

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The evaluation count is not deterministic across machines: the optimum is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0, and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation. The run stops after 16-17 evaluations (17 on the reference machine) or runs to MAXEVAL = 30, and a 1-ulp change of the hot_a0 start or of one training energy flips it; evals_tol 14 accepts 3..31.
